title: First deploy tags on production: backfill the 1eed288 deploy and prove the next scripts/deploy.sh run pushes its tag and runs the deploy-alone guard
acceptance: The conductor backfills deploy/2026-11-24T0237Z-1eed288 on 1eed288 (the 2026-11-23 deploy: Worker 515bc8fb-24fd-4ff7-b8be-6f7c28aa1e85, rollback fedc7fbf-1bc2-46cd-a90a-3059505e0a7b, SPA assets/index-CFKeSijz.js) and pushes only that ref; git ls-remote --tags origin shows it and pnpm release:status reads it.

The next real scripts/deploy.sh run on the Neo runs the deploy-alone guard against that tag, then creates and pushes its own deploy/* tag after the post-deploy checks, and the tag message holds a real Worker version and rollback version (not unknown). That deploy's HISTORY entry names the tag.
nextAction: Agent-created (round 1124 web Lane 1, 2026-11-24) for RF-244's post-merge acceptance. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. After RF-244 merges, the conductor backfills the 1eed288 tag (commands in ritmofit_dev_plan/handoffs/2026-11-24-r1124-lane1-release-marker.md); the next deploy the owner approves then proves the script path.

evidence.summary: Owner decision, Neo conductor session, recorded on iOS #113: on 2026-11-23 the owner asked for "a dependable marker to trigger deploy and TestFlight updates" and chose "Ask at every close"; on 2026-11-24 the owner answered the conductor's plan with "go". Approved: deploy.sh tags the commit it deployed (Worker version, SPA entry and rollback target in the message), pnpm release:status compares main with the newest tag and says "deploy due" or "nothing to ship", start-session reports it, and close-session asks the owner once when anything is due. Item 2, making the deploy-alone rule mechanical in deploy.sh, is the conductor's recommendation, not yet an owner decision: the owner approves it or not at this PR's merge.
